usageNotes: Returns all IP/CIDR aliases defined in a VM's firewall configuration, which can be referenced by name in firewall rules instead of raw addresses. Requires VM.Audit on the target VM — no node-level privilege is needed. Aliases are VM-scoped; to see cluster-wide aliases shared across all VMs, query the cluster firewall aliases endpoint instead.

examples.summary: List firewall aliases for VM 105 on node pve1

tips: Each returned object includes a 'digest' field — pass it to create/update/delete alias calls to guard against concurrent modifications.
Alias names are case-sensitive and must be unique within the VM's firewall scope; they do not collide with cluster-level alias names.
An empty array response means no aliases have been defined yet — the VM's firewall may still be enabled with inline CIDRs in rules.
